milestones.title: Environment and decision freeze

steps.deliverable: Pinned pnpm/TypeScript workspace, runnable configuration API/web/worker, PostgreSQL migration and Docker/CI
steps.exit: Frozen install, typecheck, unit/schema tests, web build, database restart checks and service smoke pass

steps.deliverable: Strict versioned schemas, manifest seal, three distinct profiles, integration inventory and fact sheets
steps.exit: Every required adapter has evidence or a disabled TO_VERIFY gate; incompatible routes and tampering fail validation

steps.deliverable: Project state, ADRs, scope cuts, provenance/demo plan and M1–M7 acceptance plan
steps.exit: State reflects actual evidence; focused M0 commit exists and M1 has not started

milestones.externalGate: No deployment/RPC credential required; all unresolved external integrations remain disabled

milestones.title: Deterministic accounting kernel

steps.deliverable: packages/accounting: pure global portfolio, cash/reservations/positions/receivables, asset aliases and explicit rounding helpers
steps.exit: Property tests preserve value/remainders with amounts above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER; no shared balances across networks/scenarios

steps.deliverable: Operation identity, receipt application, costs/payables/allowances and transfer reducer
steps.exit: Source failure releases reservation minus attempt costs; burn/delay/retry/settlement sequences debit once, credit once and survive serialize/reload at each boundary

steps.deliverable: Mark/liquidation contracts, pure replay fixtures and failure cases
steps.exit: Withdrawal success followed by swap failure preserves cash/costs; missing data and blocked exits remain explicit; no repeated exit-charge mutation

milestones.externalGate: None: synthetic fixtures only, clearly labeled; no API/signing/live adapter implementation required

milestones.title: First local economic slice

steps.deliverable: packages/market-data + adapters: archive inputs and first Aave USDC cash→supply→cash path
steps.exit: Exact official target/bytecode and fixed-block fork/captured fixture validate index accrual, caps, pauses, liquidity, approvals and gas

steps.deliverable: One synchronous Ethereum USDC vault family and direct Uniswap V3 USDC/USDT exact-in path with USDT supply
steps.exit: Conversions/previews/limits/virtual-holder capacity and both swap directions agree with fixed-block cases at each amount; quote fee/impact charged once

steps.deliverable: Content-addressed S3 archive and selected receipt replay
steps.exit: Another process reproduces outputs from raw block/quote/gas/feed payloads and pinned versions; stale/missing inputs stop execution

commands: Add and run pnpm test:fork with pinned blocks and explicit required RPCs
milestones.externalGate: Ethereum archive RPC, exact Aave/vault/Uniswap targets, conversion source and object store. If blocked, fixture path works but real adapter activation stays TO_VERIFY

milestones.title: Experiment, API and external agent

steps.deliverable: Agent/version/key registry, immutable experiment start, canonical policy snapshot/hash, revocation
steps.exit: No start with unresolved dependencies; policy-changing writes after X fail; a correction preserves original evidence

steps.deliverable: packages/sdk and examples/self-hosted-treasury-agent with injected EIP-712 signer
steps.exit: External process fetches policy, builds exact allocation/hash, signs locally, submits and verifies acknowledgment; key never leaves agent

steps.deliverable: Append-only economic journal, PostgreSQL queue, planner and worker acceptance/application transactions
steps.exit: Wrong domain/profile/policy/scenario/key, expiry, nonce conflict, idempotent repeat, stale version, concurrency and payload/quota cases pass; crash each durable boundary without duplicate effects

milestones.externalGate: Use local deterministic signing-domain fixture until exact Arc registry deployment exists; no fabricated verifying contract in real profile

milestones.title: Multi-capital and references

steps.deliverable: Three independent 1k/10k/100k scenario streams and two reference portfolios each
steps.exit: Equal starting global capital/distribution, distinct financial identities and amount-specific costs; one quote never silently scaled

steps.deliverable: Checkpoints and packages/valuation/evaluation descriptive outputs
steps.exit: Inactive positions accrue correctly; mark/liquidation, costs, cash, transit, drawdown and reference differences replay at the same checkpoint

steps.deliverable: Reference failure and data quality paths
steps.exit: Failed passive entry retains cash/costs and suspends comparison; no replacement after X, missing metrics never zero; correlated scenarios never triple samples

milestones.externalGate: Verified conservative reference and same observation provenance; fixtures remain synthetic if data unavailable

milestones.title: Arc and CCTP technical lifecycle

steps.deliverable: Arc/Sepolia ERC-4626 test vaults, finite funded test yield, gas/decimal alias handling
steps.exit: Actual test-token deposit/withdraw and bytecode/address evidence; finite schedule frozen before X

steps.deliverable: CCTP both directions, durable transfer worker, prefunded test relayer and fee/delay model
steps.exit: Actual Sepolia→Arc and Arc→Sepolia burn/attestation/receipt records; duplicate settlement and restart cannot credit twice; costs charged without bankroll subsidy

steps.deliverable: Delayed attestation, source failure, destination retries, reorg and closure reconciliation
steps.exit: Unresolved receivable remains unavailable; no timer-only actual settlement; late receipt cannot improve deadline result; fork/unit/live evidence remain distinct

commands: Add and run pnpm test:live:testnet (explicit testnet credentials)
milestones.externalGate: Testnet RPCs, faucets, test-only relayer/publisher keys, exact CCTP contracts/route/attestation/fees and actual transactions. M5 cannot be complete with mocks alone

milestones.title: Evaluation, commitments, export and UI

steps.deliverable: Separate compliance/economic/statistical statuses and provenance gate
steps.exit: Testnet/replay/synthetic/mixed excluded before criteria; disabled inference never produces eligibility; old reports survive corrections

steps.deliverable: packages/commitments + Arc registry, ordered leaves, batch chain and inclusion proofs
steps.exit: Valid proof passes; tampering/gaps/overlap/wrong predecessor/reorg detected; confirmed root has actual deployment/publication evidence

steps.deliverable: Read-only canonical dashboard, versioned export and independent replay command
steps.exit: Fresh process reconstructs selected receipt from exported schemas, versions, raw inputs, events and proofs, then verifies leaf and batch continuity

milestones.externalGate: Arc testnet registry publication plus archival availability. Periodic anchoring is not pre-execution public timestamp proof

milestones.title: Demo hardening

steps.deliverable: Synthetic failures, longer labeled replay and independently gated fresh Ethereum forward session
steps.exit: Recorded evidence cannot be spliced across provenance classes or claim a longer forward history

steps.deliverable: Monitoring, quotas, incident displays, operational recovery and timed runbook
steps.exit: Rehearsal completes signed action→economic consequence→references→proof/export; fallback evidence accurately labeled; errors/losses remain visible

steps.deliverable: Final acceptance and deployment/demo documentation
steps.exit: All implemented validation passes; real integration evidence is linked; limitations, TO_VERIFY leftovers and run commands accurate; focused milestone commit

milestones.externalGate: Current public network availability, bounded fresh forward observation period and stored backup evidence; no automatic real-fund allocation
